file.header: These variables may be changed anytime during a run, they control jobs that are dependent on case.run.

entry.desc: Location of CUPiD for CESM workflow
When TRUE, CUPiD will generate time series files from history output
When TRUE, CUPiD will generate diagnostic plots
When TRUE, CUPiD will generate web pages from the diagnostic plots
Conda environment to use when running CUPiD notebooks
Conda environment to use when running CUPiD tools
First year of output to include in CUPiD analysis. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
Sets the portion of output to include in CUPiD analysis, along with STOP_N.
Provides a numerical count for $CUPID_STOP_OPTION.
First date of baseline output to include in CUPiD analysis. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
Sets the portion of base case output to include in CUPiD analysis, along with STOP_N.
Provides a numerical count for $CUPID_BASE_STOP_OPTION.
Year to end climatology, eg for LDF
Number of years to use for climatology, eg for LDF
Year to end base case climatology, eg for LDF
Number of years to use for base case climatology, eg for LDF
Baseline case to use in CUPiD analysis
Baseline case root to use in CUPiD analysis
Timeseries directory for baseline case to use in generating ts. Change this in the case of directory permission issues to eg, your scratch directory

Type of CTSM run: either 'BGC' (biogeochemistry) or 'SP' (satellite phenology)
